$comment: Which wger images may be shown besides the license checks (see docs/import/wger-review.md, 'Image provenance'). wger accepts uploads from anyone and the uploader picks the license; a visual review found commercial images re-uploaded under CC licenses, so only trusted authors and individually reviewed images are used. Re-run node scripts/map-wger.mjs after editing.

trustedAuthors.Everkinetic: Everkinetic's open exercise line drawings (everkinetic.com), published under CC-BY-SA 3; wger's original illustration set.
trustedAuthors.wger.de: Drawings credited to the wger project itself.

allowedImages.272: TRX row: an ordinary photo of a person training in a gym, no branding, watermark or render style (reviewed 2026-09-30).
